messages:
Sasha: Heads-up — I noticed a regression on token-level tail latency for route embeddings/v1. The dashboard shows a jump starting ~1980012000. Anyone digging?
Matt: Yeah I saw that. KV cache evictions spiked on canary around the same time. Memory footprint stayed flat though. Quick numbers: kv_hit_rate 0.62 -> 0.35, evictions/sec 120 -> 820, avg_token_ms 18 -> 32.
Erin: Could be related to kernel selection fallback. My profiling shows more requests hitting the kernel_emu path on A100_40g nodes after the deploy.
perf-ci: automated-sample: profile_id=abcd1234; top spans delta: kv_lookup 45% -> 60%, kernel_select 10% -> 18%, kernel_exec 30% -> 25%.
Matt: We rolled a batching heuristic tweak on canary yesterday (reduced max_batch_ms from 8 -> 4 for low-latency config). Smaller batches could be changing access patterns and causing cache churn.
Sasha: @Matt which deploy/PR was that?
Matt: PR https://git/repo/changes/4123 — diff basically lowers batch window and prefers a minimal-latency kernel heuristic for mixed seq lengths.
Erin: Hypothesis: smaller batches -> fewer tokens per request in a micro-burst -> different kernel choice (small-context kernel) which changes per-shard IO ordering, increasing evictions. Also the kernel fallback path might be doing extra KV writes.
Dave: From per-route attribution: embeddings/v1 accounts for ~48% of the observed drop in prefix reuse. reuse_rate for embeddings/v1 0.78 -> 0.41 in the same window.
Sasha: Can someone pull a per-token latency breakdown panel by route and kernel? Need to split token_ms into decode / kv_lookup / kernel_exec to prove the case.
Matt: Grabbing flame graphs now. Early finding: kernel_select latency increased because we added a safety fallback for quantized kernels when seq_len > 1024; that path hits extra compatibility code.
Erin: I recommend reverting the batching tweak on canary and running an A/B: old batching vs new, with kernel selection pinned. Also add kvcache_eviction_rate as a rollout gate metric.
Dave: Created rollback runbook and gating alert. Alert: kvcache_eviction_rate > 300 sustained for 5m => auto-roll. Runbook: https://runbooks/kv-eviction-rollback (steps + who to ping).
perf-ci: Deploy 4123 rolled back on canary at 1980012365 by Matt. Action: revert batch window change and redeploy.
Matt: After rollback, quick post-check: hit_rate back to ~0.71, evictions down to ~45/s, tail token latency back to ~19ms. I'll open a follow-up PR to make batching conservative and add an explicit kernel preference map by route.
Sasha: Thanks. Can someone add a dashboard card that combines: per-route KV reuse heatmap, per-kernel token latency breakdown, and a rollout gate for kvcache_evictions? Tagging @Erin and @Dave to own instrumentation.
Erin: Added Grafana panel id=7321 and a link to the new view: https://grafana/d/7321/kv-reuse. Also enabled sampling on traces to tag kv_lookup spans with route and kernel_id.
Dave: I'll wire kvcache_reuse_by_route into the product KPI dashboard and add an alertable SLI for reuse_rate < 0.6 for important routes.
Sasha: Great. Follow-ups: (1) Matt opens conservative-batching PR with route-level kernel overrides, (2) Erin adds KV eviction to rollout gating, (3) Dave adds reuse_by_route KPI. We'll reconvene after the A/B completes. :thumbsup:
